subject: Web Development
title: HTML: The Language of the Web
description: A fast breakdown of HTML: The Language of the Web for builders.

hook.text: Every website you've ever visited is built on the same simple language: HTML.

buildup.text:
HTML uses tags like

for paragraphs and for links to structure content.

discovery.text: Berners-Lee based HTML on SGML, a markup language IBM created for legal documents.

twist.text: HTML was designed to be forgiving. If a browser hit a bad tag, it just skipped it.

climax.text: That forgiveness made HTML nearly impossible to break, helping the web grow fast.

punchline.text: A forgiving language conquered the world.

quiz.question: What language was HTML based on?
